$schema_note: TERRAFRONT continent/map registry (continents lane, 2026-07-10; W12 continent-2-data additions). DISPLAY METADATA ONLY: the geometry/zone constants (sanctuary rectangle, pad plateau, terminal, spawn pads) are compile-time constexpr in Source/World/TFSanctuaryZone.h so terrain and damage determinism never depend on a data-file load. Loaded by TFTravelSystem::LoadContinentMeta; unknown keys ignored; file optional (built-in names as fallback). mapId 0 = sanctuary, 1 = the live continent in THIS server process. W12: 'regions' names the region-lattice data file TFDataTables loads when tf_continent=<key> selects this continent at boot (default cindral_wastes); exactly ONE continent is live per server process - entries beyond the selected one are shown in the travel terminal as different-server destinations. Additive only - other lanes append new continents with new mapIds, never renumber.
